reviews.reading_evidence: Read complete fourteen-line Angel source and both full targets: angel beyond anguish rises from own ashes/lives eternally, living spirit striving to create quoted Land of the leal, urges ultimate conquerors/vision beyond sight/loves all connects none, naked-truth sense/demon control, victory and perpetual city-of-light rule/spiritual life/immortality. Checked pronoun continuity and deliberate angel/ash-rising mixture without rationalising to a named religious figure.
reviews.reason: Retain the visionary praise, paradox of loving without connection and quoted land-of-the-faithful wording; no defensible target-only correction found.
open_questions: Existing Land of the leal literal faithful/loyal-land rendering remains provisional for intertextual nuance; no named faith, place or phoenix identity added.
